reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: WC has high thermal conductivity and can form coherently at W/Cu interfaces, plausibly reducing interfacial resistance, though the claimed 15–25% improvement and simultaneous retention of all properties under irradiation are optimistic without quantitative justification.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a decisive falsification criterion (statistically significant <15% conductivity increase or compromised durability), but the practical feasibility of in situ TEM/synchrotron monitoring during hot pressing at 1400–1500 °C is questionable.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a key challenge in W–Cu composites for fusion applications with a novel, well-defined intervention and mechanism, making it highly relevant and worth testing.
